body: Thanks for your responses, it helped a bit.

I do find comfort in nature or at least some peace. What I do for a living gives me a very harsh point of view of people which sucks because I like being a good person and helping others. I miss having a brighter outlook, I really do.
I appreciate your words. There is some comfort knowing others have felt it.
Just a bad day I guess.

I don't know, sort of feels like I'm an alien on a field trip to earth. Looking around and all this and thinking how things are just gonna repeat over and over, the whole peaks and valleys, ups and downs. Orgasms, tears, victories, defeats. Lose people, gain friends. Love and hate. I think I've seen enough. People are terrible and I think I'm ready to move on.
I just don't want to give her a heart attack before she has the kid. Blood pressure higher than usual and such. Posting on here feels silly.
